name: Noah Hägglund
headline: Sound Designer, Composer & Audio Engineer
description: Stockholm-based sound designer, composer and audio engineer specializing in sound design, mixing, mastering and audio post-production for film, games, animation and commercial productions.
bio: Hello! My name is Noah Hägglund.
I am a Stockholm-based sound designer, composer and audio engineer. I create sound design and music for games, animation, film and commercial productions.
Over the past several years, I have honed my craft by working on commercial film and television projects, specializing in audio production for short format promotional films.
However, I have also successfully applied my skills to longer formats, such as dramas & documentaries.
My expertise lies in capturing & crafting high-quality audio that enhances the overall production value of these projects.

services.title: Sound Design
services.description: Design and create custom sound effects tailored to your project's specific needs. From detailed environments and movement to dramatic effects and atmospheric soundscapes.

services.title: Mixing & Mastering
services.description: Mix and master your project's audio so dialogue, music and sound effects work together clearly and effectively.

services.title: Audio Restoration
services.description: Clean up and restore existing recordings by removing unwanted noise, hiss, hum and other distractions while preserving the character of the original recording.
